name: Logi Battery Indicator
description:
Shows battery percentage and charging status in the top bar for input devices such as the Logitech MX Master and MX Keys. Keyboards with HID++ brightness control on a Bolt receiver also show their brightness in the top bar and get a brightness tile in the quick settings.

Bolt receivers need a udev rule, because the extension reads them directly. Save udev/70-logi-battery-bolt.rules from the repository on the extension homepage to /etc/udev/rules.d/ and restart the computer. All other connections work without it.
